name: M6 City Series Electric Scooter
shortDescription: The M6 City Series is a high-performance, foldable electric scooter designed for urban commuting. Featuring a 500W motor, 25-mile range, and robust 12-inch tires, it delivers a smooth, eco-friendly ride.

children.text: Experience the ultimate in urban e-mobility with the M6 City Series Electric Scooter. Engineered for performance and convenience, this electric scooter is your perfect companion for daily commutes and city adventures in the USA.

Equipped with a robust 36V/500W brushless electric motor, the M6 reaches a top speed of 35 KM/H (approx. 22 MPH) and effortlessly tackles inclines with an 18% climbing degree. The high-capacity 36V 10.4AH battery ensures a generous range of up to 40 KM (25 miles) on a single 6-7 hour charge.

Safety is paramount. The M6 features front disc brakes combined with E-ABS for responsive stopping power. Bright headlights and turn signals/tail lights ensure visibility during night rides, while the 12-inch tires provide a stable and comfortable ride over various urban terrains. With an IPX5 waterproof rating, you can confidently ride through light rain.

Stay connected with full mobile app support, allowing you to monitor your ride stats and control scooter settings directly from your smartphone. When you reach your destination, the convenient tube folding mechanism makes it easy to store and carry.

seoTitle: M6 City Series Electric Scooter | 500W Urban E-Mobility
metaDescription: Upgrade your commute with the M6 City Series Electric Scooter. Featuring a 500W motor, 25-mile range, and foldable design, it's the perfect e-mobility solution.

faq.question: What is the top speed of the M6 City Series Electric Scooter?
faq.answer: The M6 reaches a maximum speed of 35KM/H (approximately 22 MPH), making it ideal for fast city commutes.

faq.question: How long does the battery take to charge?
faq.answer: The 36V 10.4AH battery takes about 6 to 7 hours to fully charge, giving you up to 40KM (25 miles) of range.

faq.question: Is the M6 electric scooter waterproof?
faq.answer: Yes, the M6 comes with an IPX5 waterproof rating, protecting it from low-pressure water streams from any angle, making it suitable for riding in light rain.

faq.question: Does the scooter support a mobile app?
faq.answer: Yes, the M6 City Series is fully supported by our mobile app for ride tracking, adjusting settings, and scooter management.

faq.question: What is the maximum weight limit?
faq.answer: The robust frame can support a maximum load of up to 120KG (about 265 lbs).
